questions.question: SEBI is _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Statutory body.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• SEBI is the **Securities and Exchange Board of India**.
 
• It is the regulator of the Indian securities market and was established in the year **1988**.
 
• It was given statutory powers through the **SEBI Act, 1992** on 30 January 1992, thus making it a statutory body.
 
• The main functions of SEBI are
 
 
• It fulfills the requirement of the following three categories
 
 
• Issuers - It provides a marketplace for augmenting finance property for issuers.
 
• Investors - It ensures the safety and supply of accurate information on the financial market
 
• Intermediaries - It enables a competitive professional market for intermediaries.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 
 
Constitutional bodies

 
 
 
are those which have been mentioned in the Constitution of India and derive their power directly from the Constitution. eg- UPSC, Election Commission, etc.

 
 
 

 
 
Statutory bodies

 
 
 
are those which are non-constitutional and have been created by an act of the Parliament. eg- UIDAI, National Law Commission, SEBI, etc.

 
 
 

 
 
Non-statutory bodies

 
 
 
are those which are created by the executive resolution. No law backs them. eg- NTCA

 
 
 

 
 
Advisory bodies

 
 
 
are non-constitutional and non-statutory. These could be created by either private or government institutions for advisory matters. eg- Board of Trade

questions.question: What is called the maximum distance from the Sun in a planet in its orbit?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Aphelion.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aphelion:-**** **__

 __
 
• It is the maximum distance from the Sun in a planet in its orbit. It is the point where the celestial body in the orbit is farthest from the sun..
 
• When the earth reaches aphelion, the sun appears slightly smaller in the sky at any other time of year.
 
• The earth reaches aphelion only once a year.
 
• It happens near of 4th of July.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Perihelion:-**

 
 
• It is the point in the orbit where the celestial body is closest to the sun.
 
 
 
• Apogee:-​
 
 
• The point of the orbit where the satellite is farthest from the Earth is called apogee.__
 
• The maximum distance of the moon from the earth (4,06,000 km) is called apogee. 
 
 
 
• Perigee:-
 
 
• The minimum distance of the moon from the earth (3,64,000) is called perigee.

questions.question:
Photosynthesis fulfils which of the following requirements of autotrophic organisms?

I. Carbon

II. Water

III. Energy
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**I and III.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 
• Photosynthesis fulfils the carbon and energy requirements of autotrophic organisms.
 
• Photosynthesis is a process through which plants and other organisms convert light energy into chemical energy to obtain food.
 
• Autotrophic organisms are those which are capable of synthesizing their own food from inorganic substances with the help of chemical energy or light.
 
• Certain bacteria, algae, and green plants are autotrophs.

questions.question: Which among the following difference between aerobic and anaerobic respiration is INCORRECT?

options.text: Aerobic respiration takes place in presence of oxygen - Anaerobic respiration takes place in the absence of oxygen
In Aerobic respiration pyruvate is broken down into ethanol and carbon dioxide - In Anaerobic respiration, pyruvate is broken down into carbon dioxide and water
In Aerobic respiration more energy is released - In Anaerobic respiration less energy is released
Aerobic respiration takes place in mitochondria- Anaerobic respiration takes place in yeast

questions.solution:
The correct answer is

 __**In Aerobic respiration pyruvate is broken down into ethanol and carbon dioxide - In Anaerobic respiration, pyruvate is broken down into carbon dioxide and water**__

__**Explanation:**__

 
• Chemical equation of aerobic respiration- C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O (glucose + oxygen -> carbon dioxide + water)
 
• In Aerobic respiration, pyruvate is broken down into carbon dioxide and water.
 
• Chemical equation of anaerobic respiration- C₆H₁₂O₆ = 2C₂H₅OH + 2CO₂ + 2ATP (Glucose = (ethanol or lactic acid) + carbon dioxide + energy)
 
• Anaerobic respiration pyruvate is broken down into ethanol and carbon dioxide.

questions.question: Scientists from China have successfully cloned which animal for the first time?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Monkey.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 

 
• Zhong Zhong and Hua Hua are a pair of identical crab-eating macaques that were produced by scientists from the Institute of Neuroscience of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in Shanghai on 5th Dec 2017.
 
• They were created through somatic cell nuclear transfer.
 
• The same cloning technique that produced Dolly the sheep in 1996,
 
• Scientists from China successfully cloned monkeys for the first time in January 2018.
 
• Two long-tailed, and identical macaques named Hua Hua and Zhong Zhong were born to become the first primates to be cloned from a non-embryonic cell.

questions.question: What was the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) for India in 2016-17 Financial Year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**7.10%.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gross domestic product (GDP):-**

 
 
• It is the standard monetary measure of the value-added created through the production of goods and services in a country during a certain period. Hence, statements (a), (b), (c) are incorrect.
 
• As such, it also measures the income earned from that production or the total amount spent on final goods and services (fewer imports).
 
• While GDP is the single most important indicator to capture economic activity, it falls short of providing a suitable measure of people's material well-being for which alternative indicators may be more appropriate.
 
• This indicator is based on nominal GDP (also called GDP at current prices or GDP in value) and is available in different measures: US dollars and US dollars per capita (current PPPs).
 
• **The Gross Domestic Product (GDP) for India in 2016-17 Financial Year was 7.10%.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Gross national product (GNP):-**

 
 
• It is an estimate of the total value of all the final products and services turned out in a given period by the means of production owned by a country's residents.
 
• GNP is commonly calculated by taking the sum of personal consumption expenditures, private domestic investment, government expenditure, net exports, and any income earned by residents from overseas investments, minus income earned within the domestic economy by foreign residents.
 
• Net exports represent the difference between what a country exports minus any imports of goods and services.

questions.concept: Motion, Kinematic equations for uniformly accelerated motion
questions.question: Find the acceleration (in m/s²) of a body which accelerates from 25 m/s to 30 m/s in 10 seconds.
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Equation of motion: The mathematical equations used to find the final velocity, displacements, time, etc of a moving object without considering force acting on it are called equations of motion.
 
• These equations are only valid when the acceleration of the body is constant and they move in a straight line.

There are three equations of motion:

V = u + at

V2 = u2 + 2 a S

{{S}} = {{ut}} + (1)/(2){{a}}{{{t}}²}

Where, V = final velocity, u = initial velocity, s = distance traveled by the body under motion, a = acceleration of body under motion, and t = time taken by the body under motion.

CALCULATION__:

Given that:

Final velocity, v = 30 m/s; Initial velocity, u = 25 m/s; Time, t = 10s

Using v = u + at

a = (v - u)/t

a = (30 - 25)/10

a = 5/10

**Acceleration (a) = 0.5 m/s²**

Hence option 4 is correct.
tags: Kinematic equations for uniformly accelerated motion

1 km/hr = 5/18 m/sec

so, 1 m/sec = 18/5 km/hr.
